test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Rabbit : Leap :: Parrot : ?
solution:
The logic followed here is: Animal : movement of the animal 

__
 
• **Rabbit's** movement is called **leaping**.

Similarly,

 
• **Parrot's** movement is called **flying**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Fly".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Prowls - It is the movement of lion.
 
• Fly - It is the movement of birds
 
• Bird - Movement of birds is called flying.
 
• 
 
Crawl - It is the movement of reptiles.
